title: Craft hovered over New Underwood reservoir dam
place_text: New Underwood Lake Reservoir, near November 1 and November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: it's a Pythagorean triangle from November 1 to November 5 over to new Lake Reservoir and back to November 1 control I believe based on that position of new Reservoir Dam that's where that craft was it was over that body of water

plain: In 1977 a craft hung over the water at the New Underwood Lake Reservoir dam in South Dakota, says Mario Woods, a former Air Force security guard at nuclear missile sites, who says he was there. He places it by its position inside a triangle drawn between two missile sites called November 1 and November 5, the reservoir, and back to the November 1 control post. If he is right, an unknown craft was sitting right beside American nuclear weapons.
